flags.why: The common meaning ‘to cause; to give rise to’ is missing ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/sinh%20ra%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: Add: verb | to cause; to give rise to. Example: Thiếu ngủ sinh ra nhiều vấn đề sức khỏe. = Lack of sleep causes many health problems.

flags.why: ‘Vô phép’ concerns disrespect or an apologetic breach of etiquette, rather than simply lacking permission ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/vo-phep-eWuucnxHOGR8L.html)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: The verb meaning ‘to use; to spend’ is correctly spelled ‘xài’, so this card teaches the wrong word ([spelling explanation](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/sai-tien-hay-xai-tien-1793.html)).
flags.fix: Move this sense to headword ‘xài’, retaining Southern and colloquial; correct the example to: Cậu xài điện thoại gì vậy?
